name: RunApplication
label: Run Application
description: Executes an application or opens a document by executing the associated application.

fields.name: ApplicationPath
fields.label: Application path
fields.description: The path to the application or document to execute.

fields.name: CommandLineArguments
fields.label: Command line arguments
fields.description: Optional parameters to control how the application starts (e.g., a file to open or a silent mode flag). Example: "C:\report.xlsx" or "--input=data.csv --quiet".

fields.name: WorkingDirectory
fields.label: Working Directory
fields.description: The folder the application uses as its 'current location' when running. If left empty, it defaults to the application's own folder. Required only if the app needs to access files like config.json or data.csv relative to a specific path.

fields.name: WindowStyle
fields.label: Window style
fields.description: Specifies how the application window should be displayed.

selectOptions.label: Normal
selectOptions.description: The window is shown in normal size and position.

selectOptions.label: Minimized
selectOptions.description: The window is displayed as a minimized window.

selectOptions.label: Maximized
selectOptions.description: The window is displayed as a maximized window.

fields.name: AfterApplicationLaunch
fields.label: After application launch
fields.description: Specifies the behavior after launching the application.

selectOptions.label: Continue Immediately
selectOptions.description: Continue workflow execution immediately after launching the application.

selectOptions.label: Wait for Application to Load
selectOptions.description: Wait until the launched application has fully loaded before continuing.

fields.name: Timeout
fields.label: Timeout
fields.description: The maximum time (in seconds) to wait for the application to complete.

fields.name: AppProcessId
fields.label: AppProcessId
fields.description: The process ID of the launched application.

fields.name: AppExitCode
fields.label: AppExitCode
fields.description: The exit code of the application if it completes.
